scope: noiseless exact simulator measurement reuse calibration
reuse_rule: identical Pauli, StatePreparationID, ProblemID, exact estimator, and backend; parent MeasurementContextID may differ and remains auditable
measurement_flow: final energy Pauli terms seed the cache; identical terms in the next OGM distinct-gradient-term union may reuse them
success_conditions: OFF and ON energy are bitwise equal
OFF and ON gradient vectors are bitwise equal
termwise energy and gradient norm match the pinned sparse-matrix evaluator within 1e-10
ON has positive cache hits and fewer fresh exact Pauli expectation kernels
claim_boundary: No finite-shot allocation or noisy estimator is implemented.
Fresh exact Pauli expectation kernels are not paper-equivalent Measurement Cost.
No CNOT, depth, ansatz, optimizer, pruning selector, or acceptance behavior is changed.
